candidate_gates.check: classic house kick/backbeat/hat anchors in active full-groove sections; waivable for designated breaks and other explicitly selected families
related recurring 2–4 bar bass motif with controlled variations, not unrelated generated phrases
auxiliary rim/ride/ghost presence localized to sections, rather than mechanically constant
withhold some main percussion when a roll/fill is added; compare role-presence matrix
detect a meaningful role/density reduction and return where requested
recognizable base groove with selective section-specific addition/automation
duration and DJ intro/outro follow chosen release type, not 6:40 locked
evaluate actual samples and mix, do not add multiple sub/kick layers without phase evidence
do not produce an independent lead/arp/melody while current no-melody policy is active
distinguish commercial versions, third-party remakes and uncertain analysis claims
